Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

wow! interjection

also wow! (in shocked surprise), wow! (in astonishment)

classical

Plaut.
Ter.
Traupman 112: in shocked surprise
Traupman 323
Traupman 115, 409

Papae!

Other words

  • Hui! — wow! oh! (astonishment or admiration)

    also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 2.1.72: hui, dīxtī pulchrē! (Lewis & Short); Traupman 409

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.; Cic. in epistulīs)

  • Babae! — wow! wonderful! (wonder and joy)

    also used · classical · Plaut. Pers. 5.2.25: babae! basilicē tē intulistī et facētē (Lewis & Short); Traupman 409

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

  • Vah! — oh! (shocked surprise, also anger or scorn)

    also used · classical · Traupman 409

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

    Traupman writes it twice, once as vāh; Lewis & Short and the house write vah (see bah!).

Examples

  • «Papae,» inquit puer, «etiam autoraedā longā vehimur!»

    “Wow,” said the boy, “we’re going on a bus too!”composed

See also oh no!, hooray!.
